scope: Authorized provincial charging-coverage audit/supplement only. No solver, main experiment or holdout. Preserve historical inputs and the existing road graph/model. Raw/generated datasets stay outside Git.

historical.raw_availability: Absent in local/server inventories; dated public URL returned HTTP404 on2026-11-01. Exact historical extraction-loss parity is therefore not established.

fallback_source.policy: Acquire only this dated provincial PBF if historical raw cannot be recovered. Record actual bytes/hash/header timestamp. Do not call temporal changes extraction fixes. Never download national data.

resources.accounting: Measure preparation separately, including failures/cold loads/dependencies. This bounded reservation adds no solve authorization or compute purchase; stop at caps, do not reset them on retries. Solve/limited-REF carry remains5166.078454329/28800CPU seconds.

audit.first: Compare historical producer/input identities and C classification/attachment counts; raw loss remains uncertain without historical source.
audit.raw_candidates: Record station and individual charge-point tags separately, including lifecycle/access/motorcar/socket/power evidence and unknowns. Do not inflate station counts with sockets or child charge points.
audit.capabilities: Source charging tags support modeled C only when declared eligibility passes. Preserve observed and unknown fields. Do not invent operational availability, connector compatibility, per-station charging curves or CS support.
audit.geometry: Retain source node/way/relation identity and geometry; require the frozen province boundary before candidate admission. Preserve coordinate-reference and representative-point method.
audit.attachment: Existing graph only; permitted-class incoming AND outgoing edge,250m threshold, four nearest unit-sphere chord candidates with numeric/lexical node-ID tie, then WGS84 geodesic distance and same ID tie.
audit.deduplication: Keep station-to-connector/charge-point relationships and cross-source aliases. Count distinct eligible road anchors, not raw objects. No threshold relaxation to fill N.
audit.model: Existing battery/consumption and common charging curve remain modeled defaults, distinct from source observations. No road rebuild.

next_gate: After actual coverage audit, freeze a deterministic staged wider DEV design with unsupported cells and complete per-worker query+cold reservations. Do not launch it here.
